about: Channels the daily digest checks for new videos. role: main = video version of a show the curator already follows (used to spot overlap, not picked); sometimes = video version of a show the curator sometimes follows (prefer the audio pick in picks.json); outside = everything else, the main pool for video picks. podcast = the show's podcast name when the channel posts its episodes. Channel ids were checked against each channel's own page on 2026-10-30.
